evidenceDecision: P4 is finite and directly exhaustive; native runtime and storage ordering retain their existing model/consumer obligations. Mutation controls establish sensitivity of every new test, not full domain-validation or observation-delivery proof. Feature composition exhausts all three-node input orders and directly checks invalid graphs, exact handler/declaration parity and awaited reverse-phase teardown. Production dispatch refuses an unregistered feature handler before routing and retains presence replies and socket authority; the hand-recorded inventory and actor baseline remains unchanged. Memory registration checks all six RPC handlers against the same typed CLI service, independent service instances, unchanged error replies and disconnected-caller fences; the existing routing consumers cover exact TUI/core ownership and acknowledgements. These synchronous graph rules and wiring moves add no independent runtime or storage writer, so direct finite checks suffice without a new Quint model. Runtime-neutral agent reads add the declared runtime/agent list rows and verified-only screen row. The finite actor matrix and original-generation retirement schedules in agent-commands.test.ts cover the new read-only consumer; native core screen fidelity is checked through the real framed fake-core host port. No writer, retry or recovery state is added, so existing lease/core models and direct consumer schedules suffice without a new Quint state machine.

promotion.scope: Migrated browser RPC, agent CLI and browser forge policy only; independent review and CI required.
